command.name: security key-manager onboard wrapped-nkek delete
command.description: This command clears the wrapped Node Key Encryption Key (NKEK) (public and private blobs) from the cryptomod and FDE table on all the nodes.

parameter.name: node
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the node from which the wrapped Node Key Encryption Key (public and private blobs) is to be cleared.

example.p: The following example clears the wrapped Node Key Encryption Key (public and private blobs) from node1.
example.screen: cluster-1::*>security key-manager onboard wrapped-nkek delete -node node1
